title: xerosphaera clusii
intro: Xerosphaera clusii, commonly known as the "African Milk Tree", is a species of succulent plant in the family Pedilanthaceae. The African Milk Tree has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, offering health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, making it effective in treating skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of the African Milk Tree include alkaloids, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
